authoritative_claims_integrity.scope: Every claim this revision makes about the real, authoritative 42-candidate packet, checked against the evidence it claims to be based on.

checks.claim: The authoritative packet's sha256 hashes match exactly what the repository owner declared before this session ever read the files
checks.evidence: sha256sum computed independently in this session on capability_dispatch/intake/FW-CAP-DISPATCH-004.json and .md, compared byte-for-byte against the declared values BEFORE any parsing began
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- re-running sha256sum on the committed files reproduces the same digests

checks.claim: 42 candidates were extracted, none fabricated, none dropped
checks.evidence: len(packet['capability_candidates']) == 42, computed directly from the parsed JSON, cross-checked against evidence/FW-CAP-DISPATCH-004/authoritative_dispatch_output.json's candidates array length and candidate_import_report.json's candidate_summary list length -- all three independently agree
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- re-parsing the committed JSON reproduces the same count and the same 42 names

checks.claim: candidate_count was DERIVED (42), not read from a declared field
checks.evidence: the authoritative packet has no 'candidate_count' key at all (confirmed: 'candidate_count' not in packet.keys()) -- authoritative_intake.py computes derived_candidate_count = len(candidates_raw) and states this derivation explicitly in the resulting SourceObservation.source_notes, rather than silently treating a derived value as if it had been declared
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- the absence of the field, and the derivation, are both independently checkable

checks.claim: Every canonical_hint's raw, as-observed value is preserved unmodified, distinct from its normalized form
checks.evidence: schema.py's CapabilityCandidate.canonical_hint is never reassigned after construction; canonical_hint_normalized and canonical_hint_normalization_method are separate fields computed by authoritative_intake._normalize_canonical_hint(), which returns (value, method) as a pure function of the raw input with no side effect on the raw field
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- for all 9 candidates with a hint, canonical_hint_raw != canonical_hint_normalized (scheme was added) while canonical_hint_raw exactly matches the source JSON's own 'canonical_hint' string, character for character

checks.claim: All 42 candidates resolved identity as UNAVAILABLE, not VERIFIED, and this is not a bug
checks.evidence: identity.FixtureIdentityResolver was constructed with an EMPTY dict ({}) for this run -- resolve_identity() looks up candidate['normalized_name'] in that dict, finds nothing for any of the 42, and returns the documented 'no fixture entry registered' UNAVAILABLE result every single time, by construction, not by a hidden failure path
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- re-running identity.FixtureIdentityResolver({}).resolve(candidate) for any of the 42 candidates reproduces UNAVAILABLE deterministically

checks.claim: Star counts and popularity signals from the authoritative source_observations never influenced any candidate's disposition
checks.evidence: the authoritative packet's source_observations[].notes field (which references star-count screenshots) is never read by authoritative_intake.ingest_authoritative_packet() when constructing CapabilityCandidate objects -- grep confirms 'source_observations_raw' is returned in the ingestion result dict for evidence-preservation purposes only, and is never passed into schema.new_capability_candidate() or any dispatch/overlap/identity function
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- structural absence confirmed by source inspection of authoritative_intake.py's ingest_authoritative_packet(), the same method used for the test_fixture claim below

checks.claim: The dispatch decision's NO_SUFFICIENT_CANDIDATE status for the illustrative mission_request correctly reflects that some required_capabilities have neither an existing registry match nor a verified candidate
checks.evidence: DEC-601c63567bdb's required_capabilities (8 categories) vs. covered (fewer than 8, per select_smallest_sufficient_set()'s covered set) -- the gap is independently reproducible by re-running select_smallest_sufficient_set() against the same 42 UNRESOLVED-overlap candidates and the same capabilities/registry.json
checks.verdict: TRACEABLE -- covered.issuperset(required_capabilities) evaluates False for this exact input, matching the reported status

authoritative_claims_integrity.overall_verdict: No claims-integrity violations found against the authoritative packet. Every count, hash, derivation, and resolution traces to a specific, independently re-checkable object or source-code function.
